snippet.title: Heroes Suck - Release Date Announcement Trailer | September 15, 2026
snippet.description:
Heroes Suck launches September 15, 2026 on Steam!

Those cheese wheel-stealing "heroes" have raided your dungeon for the last time. Build tile by tile, line the halls with deadly traps, and use physics to send heroes flying - bowling with their bodies optional, but encouraged.

🧀 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2497980/Heroes_Suck/
🎮 Play the free demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2570590/Heroes_Suck_Demo/
💬 Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/wDez7ewb2f
🌐 Website: https://dawninglight.gg/en/games/heroes-suck

WHAT IS HEROES SUCK?
A physics-enabled tower defense where you play the dungeon, not the hero.

▸ Build your dungeon your way - place tiles and traps, expand as you level
▸ Unleash havoc - launch, burn, and electrocute heroes with full physics
▸ Learn powers - only 4 slots, so choose carefully (collateral damage counts)
▸ Grow your town - unlock the forge, scriptorium, town hall and more
▸ Uncover the mystery behind the stolen cheese wheels

Wishlisting genuinely helps a solo indie dev - it's the single biggest thing you can do to help this game launch well. Thank you. 🧀

* No heroes were harmed in the making of this game.

#IndieGame #TowerDefense #HeroesSuck #Steam #IndieDev
